Field Descriptions

RESERVED_31_24 - Reserved

Byte 15 is reserved. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 PROT_CAP. Static read-only constant (sw=r; hw=na).

HEARTBEAT_PERIOD - Heartbeat period

Byte 14 reports heartbeat period in 2^x microseconds, with 0 meaning not supported. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 PROT_CAP. Firmware-configurable (sw=rw); host writes raise PROTOCOL_ERROR.

MAX_RESP_TIME - Maximum response time

Byte 13 reports maximum response time in 2^x microseconds. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 PROT_CAP. Firmware-configurable (sw=rw); host writes raise PROTOCOL_ERROR.

NUM_OF_CMS_REGIONS - Total number of CMS regions

Byte 12 reports the number of component memory spaces. Advertises one CMS region: after the direct CMS-memory window (INDIRECT_CTRL/STATUS/DATA) was removed, only the FIFO-backed CMS region remains (OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 PROT_CAP; this count includes logging, code and vendor regions). Firmware-configurable (sw=rw), reset default 1; the USB host is RO -- a host write to PROT_CAP raises PROTOCOL_ERROR (Sec 9.1).
